documents.title: Audited financial statements
documents.text:
Audited financial statements — Brightwater Holdings (fictional).
In this document "BHH" means Brightwater Holdings. Brightwater Holdings reports capex of $29.7m for FY2024 on a reported basis under the original agreement. Brightwater Logistics subsidiary reports net debt of $217.9m for FY2024 on a reported basis. BHH reports available liquidity of $35.2m for FY2025 on a reported basis. Brightwater Holdings reports EBITDA of $83.4m for FY2024 on a reported basis. The fiscal year of Brightwater Holdings ends on 30 June.

documents.title: Lender presentation
documents.text:
Lender presentation — Brightwater Holdings (fictional).
Brightwater Holdings reports capex of $23.7m for FY2024 on a reported basis under the amendment no. 1 (supersedes). Brightwater Holdings reports net debt of $184.1m for FY2024 on a reported basis. Brightwater Holdings reports customer concentration of 22.3% for FY2025. Brightwater Holdings reports interest cover of 3.7x for LTM to 30 Jun 2025.

documents.title: Compliance certificate
documents.text:
Compliance certificate — Brightwater Holdings (fictional).
Brightwater Holdings reports available liquidity of $29m for FY2025 on a reported basis. Brightwater Holdings reports operating cash earnings of $92.5m for FY2024 on a reported basis. Brightwater Holdings reports customer concentration of 25.1% for FY2025. Brightwater Holdings reports interest cover of 3x for FY2025 (fiscal year ending 30 June 2025). "operating cash earnings" has the same meaning as "ebitda".
